row.autoSolve.question.description: First line of a notification: the automatic attempt to build the change a request asked for needs an answer from the viewer. "Change" is a noun. Which request is on the line below.

row.autoSolve.ready.description: First line of a notification: the change a request asked for was built automatically and can be tried. "Change" is a noun. Which request is on the line below.

row.autoSolve.request.description: Second line of a notification about a change built for a request. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.autoSolve.aRequest.description: Second line of a notification about a change built for a request, when the request's number is not known. "Request" is a noun; lower case.

row.spec.label.description: First line of a notification: somebody (named on the last line) shared a plan, the written description of a planned change, with the viewer. Its title is on the line below.

row.spec.version.description: Second line of the "Plan shared" notification when the plan has no title: its version number, "v" for version. {{version}} is the number, or "?" when unknown.

spec.panelTitle.description: Title of the panel that opens from a "Plan shared" notification and shows that plan, the written description of a planned change. {{version}} is the plan's version number; "v" is for version.

row.channel.many_one.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion. {{count}} is how many and {{project}} the project's name. The newest message is on the line below.

row.channel.many_other.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion. {{count}} is how many and {{project}} the project's name. The newest message is on the line below.

row.channel.manyUnnamed_one.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many.

row.channel.manyUnnamed_other.description: First line of a notification that stands for several unread messages in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many.

row.channel.snippet.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion: who wrote the newest one and what it says. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.snippetSomeone.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion, when the newest one's author is not known. {{message}} is what it says.

row.channel.someone.description: Second line of a notification for several new messages in a project's discussion, when neither the newest message's author nor its text is known.

row.channel.askedIn.description: First line of a notification: a person's message in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change. {{project}} is the project's name. Their message is on the line below. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.askedInUnnamed.text: @{{username}} asked for a change in the discussion
row.channel.askedInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification: a person's message in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change; the project's name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.someoneAskedIn.text: Someone asked for a change in {{project}}
row.channel.someoneAskedIn.description: First line of a notification: a message from an unknown person in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.channel.someoneAskedInUnnamed.text: Someone asked for a change in the discussion
row.channel.someoneAskedInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification: a message from an unknown person in a project's discussion was filed as a request for a change; the project's name is not known.

row.channel.saidIn.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion: who wrote it and in which project. {{project}} is the project's name. The message is on the line below. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.saidInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when the project's name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

row.channel.someoneIn.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when its author is not known. {{project}} is the project's name.

row.channel.someoneInUnnamed.description: First line of a notification for one new message in a project's group discussion, when neither its author nor the project's name is known.

row.inviteLink.openedOne.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: one person opened it.

row.inviteLink.openedMany_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link. {{count}} is how many people opened it; it is always more than one.

row.inviteLink.openedMany_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link. {{count}} is how many people opened it; it is always more than one.

row.inviteLink.joined.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it.

row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_one.text: Joined through your invite, with {{count}} other
row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it, and so did {{count}} more people.

row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_other.text: Joined through your invite, with {{count}} others
row.inviteLink.joinedWithOthers_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line joined the project through it, and so did {{count}} more people.

row.inviteLink.asked.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the first message of somebody who joined through it was filed as a request for a change. Their message is on the line below and their name on the last line.

row.inviteLink.saidHi.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: somebody who joined through it wrote their first message. The message is on the line below and their name on the last line.

row.inviteLink.saidHiWithOthers_one.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line wrote their first message, and so did {{count}} more people who joined through it.

row.inviteLink.saidHiWithOthers_other.description: First line of a notification to the person who made an invite link: the person named on the last line wrote their first message, and so did {{count}} more people who joined through it.

row.inviteGuard.busy_one.text: Your {{project}} invite link brought in {{count}} person today.
row.inviteGuard.busy_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when a lot of people joined through that one link within a day, which can mean it was shared further than they meant. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. A button under it turns the link off.

row.inviteGuard.busy_other.text: Your {{project}} invite link brought in {{count}} people today.
row.inviteGuard.busy_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when a lot of people joined through that one link within a day, which can mean it was shared further than they meant. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. A button under it turns the link off.

row.inviteGuard.busyPlain_one.text: Your invite link brought in {{count}} person today.
row.inviteGuard.busyPlain_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when a lot of people joined through that one link within a day, used when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. A button under it turns the link off.

row.inviteGuard.busyPlain_other.text: Your invite link brought in {{count}} people today.
row.inviteGuard.busyPlain_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when a lot of people joined through that one link within a day, used when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. A button under it turns the link off.

row.inviteGuard.paused_one.text: Your {{project}} invite link is paused: {{count}} person joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
row.inviteGuard.paused_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when so many people joined through that one link within a day that it stopped letting more in. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. Buttons under it open the link again or turn it off.

row.inviteGuard.paused_other.text: Your {{project}} invite link is paused: {{count}} people joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
row.inviteGuard.paused_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when so many people joined through that one link within a day that it stopped letting more in. {{project}} is the project's name; {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. Buttons under it open the link again or turn it off.

row.inviteGuard.pausedPlain_one.text: Your invite link is paused: {{count}} person joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
row.inviteGuard.pausedPlain_one.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when so many people joined through that one link within a day that it stopped letting more in, used when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. Buttons under it open the link again or turn it off.

row.inviteGuard.pausedPlain_other.text: Your invite link is paused: {{count}} people joined through it today. Open it again if that's expected.
row.inviteGuard.pausedPlain_other.description: The whole text of a notification to the person who made an invite link, when so many people joined through that one link within a day that it stopped letting more in, used when the project's name is not known. {{count}} is how many people joined through it in the last day. Buttons under it open the link again or turn it off.

row.inviteGuard.turnOff.description: Button on a notification about one of the reader's invite links that brought in a lot of people in a day: stops the link working, for good.

row.inviteGuard.reopen.description: Button on a notification about one of the reader's invite links that paused itself after a lot of people joined through it in a day: lets people join through it again.

row.inviteGuard.turnedOff.description: Short confirmation shown after the reader turned one of their invite links off from a notification.

row.inviteGuard.reopened.description: Short confirmation shown after the reader opened one of their paused invite links again from a notification: people can join through it again.

row.inviteGuard.failed.text: Could not change the invite link. Try again.
row.inviteGuard.failed.description: Error shown when turning an invite link off, or opening it again, from a notification did not work.

row.collab.invitedJoin.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line invited the viewer into the private project named there.

row.collab.invitedBuild.text: Invited you to build with them
row.collab.invitedBuild.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line invited the viewer to work on the project named there. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

row.collab.accepted.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line accepted the viewer's invitation and joined the project.

row.collab.approverInvite.text: Asked you to help approve changes
row.collab.approverInvite.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line asked the viewer to become one of the people whose approval a project's changes need. "Changes" is a noun.

row.collab.approverAccepted.description: The whole text of a notification: the person named on the last line agreed to become an approver of the project's changes. "Changes" is a noun.

row.chat.mention.description: First line of a notification: somebody named the viewer with @ in a project's chat. The message is on the line below and who wrote it on the last line.

row.chat.reply.description: First line of a notification: somebody replied to the viewer's message in a project's chat. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.threadReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody answered in a reply thread the viewer started or took part in, in a project's chat. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.posted.description: First line of a notification about a chat message of a kind this version does not know. A past-tense verb: "(they) posted", wrote a message. The message is on the line below.

saved.heading.description: Heading over what the viewer bookmarked in the notifications sheet — saved messages and saved notifications — at the top of the screen.

saved.unsave.description: Button beside a saved message or a saved notification in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: removes the bookmark from it.

saved.system.description: Stands for the author of a saved message that the platform itself wrote. Only its first letter is shown, in the round avatar beside the message.

saved.notificationLine.description: First line over a saved notification in the notifications sheet's Saved section: what kind of notification it is, and when it was saved. {{kind}} is the kind line the row shows in the list ("New reply", "Mention"), {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.author.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet: who wrote it, where, and when it was saved. {{place}} is the name of the project or conversation, {{when}} is how long ago ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.authorConversation.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet when it was written in a conversation that has no name. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.authorApp.description: Line over a saved message in the notifications sheet when it was written in an app's chat and the app's name is not known. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date. Keep the @ before the username.

saved.line.system.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote. {{place}} is the name of the project or conversation it is in, {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.systemConversation.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote in a conversation that has no name. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

saved.line.systemApp.description: Line over a saved message that the platform itself wrote in an app's chat whose name is not known. {{when}} is how long ago it was saved ("2h ago") or a date.

invite.heading.description: Heading over the invitations waiting for the viewer's answer, at the top of the notifications sheet. A plural noun.

invite.accept.description: Button on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: accepts the invitation to the project.

invite.decline.description: Button on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet, and the action revealed by swiping it: turns the invitation down.

invite.showMore_one.description: Button under the first pending invitations in the notifications sheet: unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many are hidden.

invite.showMore_other.description: Button under the first pending invitations in the notifications sheet: unfolds the rest. {{count}} is how many are hidden.

invite.note.description: The inviter's own note, quoted under a pending invitation. {{note}} is what they wrote; only the quotation marks are translated.

invite.someone.description: Stands for the inviter on a pending invitation when their name is not known. Only its first letter is shown, in the round avatar beside the invitation.

invite.members_one.description: Under a pending invitation to a private project. {{count}} is how many members the project has. "It" is the project.

invite.members_other.description: Under a pending invitation to a private project. {{count}} is how many members the project has. "It" is the project.

invite.alreadyIn.description: Under a pending invitation to a project the viewer already belongs to (they joined through a link or the Join button while the invitation was still waiting). "It" is the project.

invite.meta.membersWhen.description: Small line under a pending invitation. {{members}} is the finished phrase saying how many people are in the project and {{when}} how long ago the invitation was sent. Only the separator between them is translated; keep it inside the first tag.

invite.line.approve.text: <0>@{{username}}</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>{{project}}</1>
invite.line.approve.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to {{project}}, the project's name. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.approveUnnamed.text: <0>@{{username}}</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>an app</1>
invite.line.approveUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to an app whose name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneApprove.text: <0>Someone</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>{{project}}</1>
invite.line.someoneApprove.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to {{project}}, the project's name.

invite.line.someoneApproveUnnamed.text: <0>Someone</0> asked you to help approve changes to <1>an app</1>
invite.line.someoneApproveUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known asked the viewer to become an approver of changes to an app whose name is not known either.

invite.line.join.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer into the private project {{project}}. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.joinUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer into a private project whose name is not known. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneJoin.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer into the private project {{project}}.

invite.line.someoneJoinUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer into a private project whose name is not known either.

invite.line.build.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer to work on the project {{project}}. "Build" is a verb: make the project together. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.buildUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. {{username}} invited the viewer to work on an app whose name is not known. "Build" is a verb: make it together. Keep the @ before the username.

invite.line.someoneBuild.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer to work on the project {{project}}. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.line.someoneBuildUnnamed.description: Sentence on a pending invitation in the notifications sheet. The names in <0> and <1> are shown bold. A person whose name is not known invited the viewer to work on an app whose name is not known either. "Build" is a verb: make it together.

invite.acceptFailed.description: Brief message shown when accepting an invitation failed and the server gave no reason. {{status}} is the numeric HTTP status code; keep "HTTP".

invite.acceptedBuild.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted an invitation to work on the project {{project}} (the project's name). "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.acceptedBuildUnnamed.text: You can now build this project
invite.acceptedBuildUnnamed.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted an invitation to work on a project whose name is not known. "Build" is a verb: make the project together.

invite.declined.description: Brief message shown after the viewer turned a pending invitation down from the notifications sheet.

toast.markAllFailed.text: Couldn’t mark notifications as read. Try again.
toast.markAllFailed.description: Brief message shown when "Mark all read" or "Mark everything older than a week as read" failed.

toast.markAppFailed.text: Couldn’t mark these notifications as read. Try again.
toast.markAppFailed.description: Brief message shown when the Mark read button beside an app's name on the notifications sheet's Unread filter failed.

toast.clearFailed.text: Couldn’t clear this notification. Try again.
toast.clearFailed.description: Brief message shown when marking one notification as read (clearing it) failed.

toast.saveFailed.text: Couldn’t save this notification. Try again.
toast.saveFailed.description: Brief message shown when saving a notification (pinning it in the Saved section) failed.

toast.unsaveFailed.text: Couldn’t unsave this notification. Try again.
toast.unsaveFailed.description: Brief message shown when removing the save from a saved notification failed.

friend.answerFailed.text: Couldn’t answer this friend request. Try again.
friend.answerFailed.description: Brief message shown when accepting or declining a friend request from its notification failed.

friend.nowFriends.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted a friend request from its notification. Keep the @ before the username.

friend.nowFriendsUnnamed.description: Brief message shown after the viewer accepted a friend request from its notification, when the other person's username is not known.

friend.withdrawn.description: Brief message shown when the viewer pressed Accept on a friend request that its sender had already taken back. "Request" is the friend request.

friend.declined.description: Brief message shown after the viewer declined a friend request from its notification. "Request" is the friend request.

row.chat.requestReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the viewer filed or posted in. {{number}} is the request's number. "Request" is a noun: something people asked a project for. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.requestReplyUnnumbered.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a request the viewer filed or posted in, when the request's number is not known. "Request" is a noun: something people asked a project for. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.changeReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a change (a proposed edit to a project that people vote on) the viewer built, voted on or posted in. {{number}} is the change's number. "Change" is a noun. The message is on the line below.

row.chat.decisionReply.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a decision the viewer voted on or posted in, such as renaming a project. "Decision" is a noun: something a project's people vote on. The message is on the line below.

row.projectOpened.label.description: A notification row in the notifications sheet: a project the reader joined while it was still being made has just gone live. The project's name is shown on the line beside it. "It" is the project.

row.inviteNudge.voted.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they voted on something. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.votedUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they voted on something. Used when the project's name is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.posted.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they wrote a message. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.postedUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they wrote a message. Used when the project's name is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.asked.text: You asked for a change in {{project}}
row.inviteNudge.asked.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they asked for a change. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.askedUnnamed.text: You asked for a change in a project
row.inviteNudge.askedUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they asked for a change. Used when the project's name is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.changed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they made a change. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.changedUnnamed.text: You made a change in a project
row.inviteNudge.changedUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they made a change. Used when the project's name is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.used.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they used its app. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.usedUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there: they used its app. Used when the project's name is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.plain.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there, when what that was is not known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two. {{project}} is the project's name. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where Invite is.

row.inviteNudge.plainUnnamed.description: First line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, sent once after the first thing they did there, when neither what that was nor the project's name is known. The line below asks them to invite a friend or two.

row.inviteNudge.ask.text: It's better with your people: invite one or two friends? They can use it straight away and help shape it.
row.inviteNudge.ask.description: Second line of a notification from Homeroom bot to somebody new to a project, under a line saying what they first did there. "It" is the project. Tapping the row opens the project's page, where the Invite button is.

ask.invite_sent.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears right after the person sent an invite link to their project.

ask.invite_sent.body.text: We’ll tell you when someone opens your invite, and when they join.
ask.invite_sent.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after an invite link was sent.

ask.suggestion.title.text: Get a ping when it’s ready?
ask.suggestion.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears after the person suggested a change that Homeroom bot (the platform's assistant) is now building.

ask.suggestion.body.text: Homeroom bot will message you when your idea is ready to try.
ask.suggestion.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after a suggestion Homeroom bot is building.

ask.reply.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears after the person sent a message to someone, or in a project's chat.

ask.reply.body.text: Get a notification when somebody replies to you.
ask.reply.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, after a message was sent.

ask.community.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears on the page of a project (a community) the person joined. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.community.small.body.text: Get a notification when the group writes here, and when a change needs your vote.
ask.community.small.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a small private project where every message notifies the group.

ask.community.large.body.text: Get a notification when a change needs your vote, and when somebody replies to you.
ask.community.large.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a larger or public project where ordinary messages do not notify everyone.

ask.project_opens.title.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. This one appears to somebody who joined a project that is still being made. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.project_opens.body.text: We’ll tell you as soon as it’s ready to use.
ask.project_opens.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown inside the Homeroom phone app; its button then shows the phone's own permission prompt. The line under the title, on a project still being made.

ask.notifyMe.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. The card's main button: yes, notify me.

ask.notNow.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. The card's second button: closes the card without turning anything on.

ask.on.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. What the card says, with a check mark, once notifications are on.

ask.off.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. What the card says only when the phone reported that notifications were refused.

ask.unsure.text: We couldn’t check notifications on this phone.
ask.unsure.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. What the card says, in place of the question, when the phone's answer could not be read after Notify me. No retry button is shown.

ask.turnOn.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. A button beside that line that opens the phone's notification settings for Homeroom.

ask.web.title.app_building.text: Get the app to hear when it’s ready
ask.web.title.app_building.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown while Homeroom bot builds the person's new project.

ask.web.title.invite_sent.text: Get the app to hear when they join
ask.web.title.invite_sent.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown right after the person sent an invite link.

ask.web.title.suggestion.text: Get the app to hear when it’s ready
ask.web.title.suggestion.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown after a suggestion Homeroom bot is now building.

ask.web.title.reply.text: Get the app to hear when they answer
ask.web.title.reply.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown after the person sent a message.

ask.web.title.community.text: Get the app to hear from {{project}}
ask.web.title.community.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown on a project the person joined. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.web.title.project_opens.text: Get the app to hear when {{project}} opens
ask.web.title.project_opens.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. Shown on a project still being made. {{project}} is the project's name.

ask.web.body.text: Homeroom’s notifications come through its phone app.
ask.web.body.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The line under the title.

ask.web.bodyEmail.text: Homeroom’s notifications come through its phone app. Until then, we’ll email you.
ask.web.bodyEmail.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The line under the title, in place of the one above, when Homeroom emails the person about this moment while they have no app.

ask.web.getApp.description: Part of the notification ask: a small card that appears at a moment when the person has just started waiting on something, asking whether Homeroom may notify them about it. Shown in a web browser, where Homeroom cannot send notifications: it offers the Homeroom phone app instead. The card's main button: opens the app's store page, or on a computer a code to scan with a phone.

ask.sheet.title.description: Title of a small sheet opened from the notification ask's Get the app button on a computer. It shows a code to scan with a phone.

ask.sheet.scan.text: Scan this with your phone’s camera. It opens the app’s page in your phone’s store.
ask.sheet.scan.description: Under that title, beside the code to scan.

ask.sheet.or.text: Or open the store on your phone
ask.sheet.or.description: Small heading over links to the app's store pages, under the code to scan.

ask.sheet.codeLabel.text: Code to scan for the Homeroom app
ask.sheet.codeLabel.description: Accessible name of the code image on that sheet.

row.chat.changeReplyPr.description: First line of a notification: somebody posted in the discussion of a change on a project whose code is on GitHub, where a change's number is written PR, not #. The viewer built it, voted on it or posted in it. {{number}} is the change's number. "Change" is a noun. The message is on the line below.

row.changeClosed.label.description: First line of a notification telling the viewer that a change they made was closed without going live. An adjective describing the change. The change's title is on the line below, followed by one sentence saying why.

row.changeClosed.yourChange.description: Second line of a notification that the viewer's change was closed, when the change has no title. Lower case: it stands where the title would.

limits.heading.description: Small-caps label over the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): limits that, when reached, make Homeroom refuse people until an admin raises them. Also the area's accessible name.

limits.foot.text: Only full admins see this. A row stays until its figure is back under its line.
limits.foot.description: Line at the foot of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). It explains that the rows cannot be dismissed: each one leaves only once the limit is no longer near.

limits.kicker.near.description: Small coloured word over a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the count is past 80% of the limit.

limits.kicker.at.description: Small coloured word over a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the count has reached the limit, so Homeroom is refusing people.

limits.kicker.over.description: Small coloured word over a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the count is above the limit (full admins can go past it).

limits.kicker.low.description: Small coloured word over the OpenRouter credit row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the credit is under its warning line.

limits.kicker.out.description: Small coloured word over the OpenRouter credit row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the credit has run out.

limits.kicker.unknown.description: Small grey word over a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the figure could not be read just now.

limits.apps.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is how many apps count toward the server's app limit, {{cap}} is that limit.

limits.apps.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the app count could not be read.

limits.apps.near_one.text: New projects stop at {{cap}} for everyone but full admins. {{count}} left.
limits.apps.near_one.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the app count. {{cap}} is the limit; {{count}} is how many more apps can be made (one).

limits.apps.near_other.text: New projects stop at {{cap}} for everyone but full admins. {{count}} left.
limits.apps.near_other.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the app count. {{cap}} is the limit; {{count}} is how many more apps can be made.

limits.apps.at.text: New projects are refused for everyone but full admins.
limits.apps.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the app limit is reached.

limits.apps.over.text: Only full admins can still make projects. Everyone else is refused.
limits.apps.over.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when more apps count than the limit allows.

limits.sessions.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is how many coding sessions are running, {{cap}} is the session limit.

limits.sessions.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the session count could not be read.

limits.sessions.near.text: At {{cap}}, new sessions pause idle ones, then are refused.
limits.sessions.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the session count. {{cap}} is the session limit.

limits.sessions.at.text: New sessions pause idle ones, and are refused when none are idle.
limits.sessions.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the session limit is reached.

limits.connections.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is how many connections the shared database has open, {{cap}} is the number at which apps are refused new ones.

limits.connections.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the connection count could not be read.

limits.connections.near.text: At {{cap}}, apps can't open new connections and their pages start failing.
limits.connections.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the database connection count. {{cap}} is the line where apps are refused.

limits.connections.at.text: Apps can't open new connections, so their pages are failing.
limits.connections.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the database has no connections left for apps.

limits.credit.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{amount}} is the credit left in the OpenRouter account, which pays for Homeroom bot's building, as a dollar amount.

limits.credit.titleOut.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit for Homeroom bot has run out.

limits.credit.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit could not be read.

limits.credit.near_one.text: Under {{line}}. At the recent rate that lasts about a day. At $0 the bot stops planning and building.
limits.credit.near_one.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the OpenRouter credit, when it lasts about one day. {{line}} is the dollar level it warns at. "The recent rate" is how fast the account's credit has been going down over the last few days.

limits.credit.near_other.text: Under {{line}}. At the recent rate that lasts about {{count}} days. At $0 the bot stops planning and building.
limits.credit.near_other.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the OpenRouter credit. {{line}} is the dollar level it warns at, {{count}} how many days the credit lasts at the rate it has been going down over the last few days.

limits.credit.nearNoDays.text: Under {{line}}. At $0 the bot stops planning and building.
limits.credit.nearNoDays.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the credit left, when this week's spend is not known. {{line}} is the warning line in dollars.

limits.credit.out.text: The bot's plans and builds are paused, and pick up again once there is credit.
limits.credit.out.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit has run out.

limits.credit.outSince.text: Out since {{time}}. The bot's plans and builds are paused, and pick up again once there is credit.
limits.credit.outSince.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit has run out. {{time}} is the time of day it ran out, for example 14:02.

limits.credit.unknownNoAnswer.text: The last read got no answer from OpenRouter. The last figure was {{amount}}.
limits.credit.unknownNoAnswer.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit could not be read. {{amount}} is the last credit figure that was read, in dollars.

limits.credit.unknownStale.text: Not read since {{time}}. The last figure was {{amount}}.
limits.credit.unknownStale.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the credit has not been read for a while. {{time}} is the time of day of the last read; {{amount}} is the figure it found, in dollars.

limits.unknown.read.text: This figure couldn't be read just now.
limits.unknown.read.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when a limit's count could not be read.

limits.turnedAway_one.text: 1 person was turned away since it filled.
limits.turnedAway_one.description: Sentence added to a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many people were refused because the limit was reached. English spells the one out.

limits.turnedAway_other.text: {{count}} people were turned away since it filled.
limits.turnedAway_other.description: Sentence added to a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): {{count}} is how many people were refused because the limit was reached.

limits.action.raise.description: Button on a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): opens Admin, Limits, where the limit is raised.

limits.action.credit.description: Button on the credit row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): opens OpenRouter's credits page in a new tab.

limits.action.status.description: Button on the database connections row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): opens Admin, Health and status, which shows the connections.

limits.action.check.description: Button on a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) whose figure could not be read: reads it again.

limits.action.checking.description: The Check again button of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) while the figures are being read again.

limits.action.newTab.description: Hidden text for screen readers after a button of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) that opens another site in a new tab.

limits.unknown.stale.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when a cluster figure has not been read for a while. {{time}} is the time of day of the last read.

limits.action.cluster.description: Button on a row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) about the cluster (the database disk, a namespace quota, a node's volume pool): opens Admin, Health and status.

limits.dbDisk.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is how much of the shared database's disk is used and {{cap}} its size, both in GiB.

limits.dbDisk.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the database disk could not be read.

limits.dbDisk.near.text: When it fills, Postgres stops writing and every app's saves fail.
limits.dbDisk.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under the database disk figure, when it is past 80%.

limits.dbDisk.at.text: Postgres has no room to write, so saves are failing. The volume needs to grow.
limits.dbDisk.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the shared database's disk is full.

limits.nodePool.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is how much of the fullest node's local volume pool is taken and {{cap}} its size, both in GiB.

limits.nodePool.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the nodes' local volume pools could not be read.

limits.nodePool.node.description: Start of the row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) for a node's volume pool. {{node}} is the server's name in the cluster.

limits.nodePool.near.text: When it fills, new worker and preview volumes fail to mount.
limits.nodePool.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the node's name, when its volume pool is past 80%.

limits.nodePool.at.text: New worker and preview volumes are failing to mount.
limits.nodePool.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the node's name, when its volume pool is full.

limits.quota.figure.description: Start of the row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) for a cluster quota: its tightest resource. {{resource}} is that resource's name (such as "CPU requested"), {{used}} and {{hard}} how much is used and the quota's ceiling.

limits.quota.resource.pods.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many pods (running containers) the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.cpu.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): CPU cores reserved by the namespace's pods.

limits.quota.resource.cpu_limits.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the CPU cores the namespace's pods may burst to, added up.

limits.quota.resource.memory.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): memory reserved by the namespace's pods.

limits.quota.resource.memory_limits.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the memory the namespace's pods may use at most, added up.

limits.quota.resource.scratch.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): temporary disk reserved by the namespace's pods.

limits.quota.resource.scratch_limits.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the temporary disk the namespace's pods may use at most, added up.

limits.quota.resource.storage.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): disk requested by the namespace's volumes.

limits.quota.resource.volumes.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many volume claims the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.services.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many Kubernetes Services the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.secrets.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many Kubernetes Secrets the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.config_maps.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many Kubernetes ConfigMaps the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.jobs.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many Kubernetes Jobs the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.resource.builds.description: Name of a cluster quota resource in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): how many image builds the namespace may hold.

limits.quota.apps.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) for the cluster quota of the namespace apps and previews run in. {{percent}} is how full its tightest resource is.

limits.quota.apps.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the cluster quota of the namespace apps and previews run in could not be read.

limits.quota.apps.near.text: When it fills, apps and previews can't start.
limits.quota.apps.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace apps and previews run in is past 80%.

limits.quota.apps.at.text: Apps and previews can't start until some stop or the quota is raised.
limits.quota.apps.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace apps and previews run in is used up.

limits.quota.workers.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) for the cluster quota of the namespace coding sessions and checks run in. {{percent}} is how full its tightest resource is.

limits.quota.workers.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the cluster quota of the namespace coding sessions and checks run in could not be read.

limits.quota.workers.near.text: When it fills, new coding sessions and checks wait.
limits.quota.workers.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace coding sessions and checks run in is past 80%.

limits.quota.workers.at.text: New coding sessions and checks are waiting for room.
limits.quota.workers.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace coding sessions and checks run in is used up.

limits.quota.builds.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) for the cluster quota of the namespace image builds run in. {{percent}} is how full its tightest resource is.

limits.quota.builds.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when the cluster quota of the namespace image builds run in could not be read.

limits.quota.builds.near.text: When it fills, new image builds fail.
limits.quota.builds.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace image builds run in is past 80%.

limits.quota.builds.at.text: New image builds are failing until old ones are cleared or the quota is raised.
limits.quota.builds.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), after the quota's tightest resource, when the quota of the namespace image builds run in is used up.

limits.kicker.usedUp.description: Small coloured word over the Homeroom bot weekly budget row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): the week's budget is all spent, so the bot has stopped building.

limits.budget.title.text: Homeroom bot's weekly budget: {{used}} of {{cap}} used
limits.budget.title.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only). {{used}} is what Homeroom bot has spent on AI models this week and {{cap}} its weekly budget, both dollar amounts.

limits.budget.titleUnknown.description: Row title in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when Homeroom bot's weekly spending could not be read.

limits.budget.near.text: At {{cap}} the bot stops building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features stop with it, until {{day}} or until the budget is raised.
limits.budget.near.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under Homeroom bot's weekly budget, when 80% or more of it is used. {{cap}} is the budget as a dollar amount, {{day}} the name of the day it starts again, such as Monday. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.

limits.budget.nearNoDay.text: At {{cap}} the bot stops building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features stop with it, until the budget is raised.
limits.budget.nearNoDay.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only), under Homeroom bot's weekly budget, when 80% or more of it is used and the day it starts again is not known. {{cap}} is the budget as a dollar amount. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.

limits.budget.at.text: The bot has stopped building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features have stopped with it. They start again on {{day}}, or as soon as the budget is raised.
limits.budget.at.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when Homeroom bot's weekly budget is all spent. {{day}} is the name of the day the budget starts again, such as Monday. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.

limits.budget.atNoDay.text: The bot has stopped building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features have stopped with it. They start again as soon as the budget is raised.
limits.budget.atNoDay.description: Row text in the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only) when Homeroom bot's weekly budget is all spent and the day it starts again is not known. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.

limits.action.budget.description: Button on the Homeroom bot weekly budget row of the platform limits area (top of the notifications sheet, full admins only): opens Admin, Homeroom bot, Settings, where the weekly budget is set.

row.limit.connections.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the shared database has no connections left for apps.

row.limit.connections.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the shared database is past 80% of the connections apps may open.

row.limit.connections.full.body_one.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} database connections open.</0> Apps can't open new ones, so their pages fail until some close.
row.limit.connections.full.body_one.description: Second line of the "Database connections used up" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many are open and {{count}} the line where apps are refused. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.connections.full.body_other.text: <0>{{used}} of {{count}} database connections open.</0> Apps can't open new ones, so their pages fail until some close.
row.limit.connections.full.body_other.description: Second line of the "Database connections used up" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many are open and {{count}} the line where apps are refused. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.connections.warn.body_one.description: Second line of the "Database connections running low" notification to an administrator. {{used}} is how many are open and {{count}} the line where apps are refused. The part in <0> is shown bold.

row.limit.dbDisk.warn.body.text: <0>{{used}} of {{cap}} GiB used.</0> When it fills, Postgres stops writing.
row.limit.dbDisk.warn.body.description: Second line of the "Database disk filling up" notification to an administrator. {{used}} and {{cap}} are GiB used and the disk's size.

row.limit.dbDisk.full.body.description: Second line of the "Database disk full" notification to an administrator. {{used}} and {{cap}} are GiB used and the disk's size.

row.limit.nodePool.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: a server's local volume pool is past 80% full.

row.limit.nodePool.warn.body.text: <0>{{used}} of {{cap}} GiB taken.</0> When it fills, new volumes fail to mount.
row.limit.nodePool.warn.body.description: Second line of the "Node volume pool filling up" notification to an administrator. {{used}} and {{cap}} are GiB taken and the pool's size.

row.limit.nodePool.full.body.description: Second line of the "Node volume pool full" notification to an administrator. {{used}} and {{cap}} are GiB taken and the pool's size.

row.limit.quota.apps.warn.body.text: <0>{{percent}}% used.</0> When it fills, apps and previews can't start.
row.limit.quota.apps.warn.body.description: Second line of the "Apps quota running low" notification to an administrator. {{percent}} is how full the quota's tightest resource is.

row.limit.quota.apps.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the cluster quota for apps and previews is used up.

row.limit.quota.apps.full.body.text: <0>{{percent}}% used.</0> Apps and previews can't start until the quota is raised.
row.limit.quota.apps.full.body.description: Second line of the "Apps quota used up" notification to an administrator. {{percent}} is how full the quota's tightest resource is.

row.limit.quota.workers.warn.body.text: <0>{{percent}}% used.</0> When it fills, new coding sessions and checks wait.
row.limit.quota.workers.warn.body.description: Second line of the "Workers quota running low" notification to an administrator. {{percent}} is how full the quota's tightest resource is.

row.limit.quota.workers.full.body.text: <0>{{percent}}% used.</0> New coding sessions and checks wait until the quota is raised.
row.limit.quota.workers.full.body.description: Second line of the "Workers quota used up" notification to an administrator. {{percent}} is how full the quota's tightest resource is.

row.limit.quota.builds.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: the cluster quota for image builds is past 80% used.

row.limit.quota.builds.warn.body.text: <0>{{percent}}% used.</0> When it fills, new image builds fail.
row.limit.quota.builds.warn.body.description: Second line of the "Builds quota running low" notification to an administrator. {{percent}} is how full the quota's tightest resource is.

row.limit.botBudget.warn.label.text: Homeroom bot's weekly budget is {{percent}}% used
row.limit.botBudget.warn.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: Homeroom bot has used most of the money it may spend on AI models this week. {{percent}} is how much of the week's budget is used, from 80 to 99.

row.limit.botBudget.warn.body.text: <0>{{used}} of {{cap}} used.</0> At {{cap}} the bot stops building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features stop with it, until {{day}}.
row.limit.botBudget.warn.body.description: Second line of the "weekly budget is … used" notification to an administrator. {{used}} and {{cap}} are dollar amounts: what Homeroom bot's key has spent this week and its weekly budget. {{day}} is the name of the day the budget starts again, such as Monday. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.

row.limit.botBudget.full.label.text: Homeroom bot's weekly budget is used up
row.limit.botBudget.full.label.description: First line of a notification to an administrator: Homeroom bot has spent all the money it may spend on AI models this week.

row.limit.botBudget.full.body.text: The bot stopped building, and screenshots, sync with main and apps' AI features stopped with it. They start again on {{day}}, or once the budget is raised.
row.limit.botBudget.full.body.description: Second line of the "weekly budget is used up" notification to an administrator. {{day}} is the name of the day the weekly budget starts again, such as Monday. The bot's key also pays for before and after screenshots of changes, for syncing a change with main, and for the AI features of people's apps, so they stop too.
